date_note: El Mostrador (22 November) reports the attack as ongoing and gives no start day; the article's publication day is used. An earlier El Mostrador report is linked in the article but was not read.
exec: The ministry says it contained the attack; El Mostrador's sources said the consular system was still affected.
geo_basis: Chile's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Santiago, as named in the source
impact: The ministry says its services continue without interruption; Canal 9 says the scope and exposed data remain unclear. El Mostrador reported the attack was not contained after more than three weeks.
plain: Chile's foreign ministry says it contained a cyberattack and its platforms work normally. El Mostrador, citing its sources, had reported the consular system was still affected after more than three weeks.
summary: Canal 9 reports that Chile's Foreign Ministry says it detected and contained a cyberattack on its IT systems and that its platforms work normally. El Mostrador had reported on 22 November, citing its sources, that the Consular Attention System was not contained after more than three weeks. ANCI has opened an investigation and Navy intelligence visited, per El Mostrador.
title: Chile's foreign ministry says it contained a cyberattack; El Mostrador reported the consular system still compromised

validation.note: Corroborated by two independent publishers, Canal 9 and El Mostrador. Canal 9 relays the ministry's own statement that it contained a cyberattack; El Mostrador independently reported the attack on 22 November. The two differ on whether it is contained.

review.note: Compared title, date, developing status, more than three weeks not contained, phishing, ANCI, DIRINTA, ministry non-response against El Mostrador
